text:
Repairs to the Tamsin Reservoir spillway cost 12 million, the Tamsin Basin Water Authority confirmed this month, coming in 1.5 million under the original estimate.

Dr. Halvard Quillon, the Authority's chief engineer, signed off on the costs when the final invoice was approved on 14 March 2024. The work replaced 340 meters of cracked spillway lining.

The figure appears in the Authority's Annual Infrastructure Expenditure Report, which was presented at the public board meeting on 21 March 2024. I attended that meeting and saw the report's total for the repair listed as 12 million.

The underspend was noted by board members during the session. The report lists the spillway lining replacement as completed, with the invoice closed out and no further charges outstanding for the project.

Residents with questions about the report can ask the Authority for a copy of the document, which was made available at the meeting.
